functions.name: conversation_has_any_members
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conversation_has_any_members(p_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.conversation_members
    WHERE conversation_id = p_conversation_id
  );
$function$

functions.name: is_owner_or_admin_of_conversation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_owner_or_admin_of_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM conversation_members
    WHERE conversation_id = p_conversation_id
      AND user_id = auth.uid()
      AND role IN ('owner','admin')
  );
$function$

functions.name: can_send_in_conversation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_send_in_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN NOT c.is_group THEN true
      WHEN c.is_note THEN true
      WHEN COALESCE(c.permissions->>'send_messages', 'everyone') = 'everyone' THEN true
      ELSE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM conversation_members cm
        WHERE cm.conversation_id = p_conversation_id
          AND cm.user_id = auth.uid()
          AND cm.role IN ('owner', 'admin')
      )
    END
  FROM conversations c
  WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_member_of_conversation(p_conversation_id uuid)

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_conversation_last_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE conversations
    SET last_message_id = NEW.id,
        last_message_at = NEW.created_at,
        last_sender_id = NEW.sender_id,
        updated_at = NEW.created_at
    WHERE id = NEW.conversation_id;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_conversation_member(conv_id uuid, uid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from conversation_members
    where conversation_id = conv_id and user_id = uid
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.conversation_created_by(p_conversation_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.conversations c
        WHERE c.id = p_conversation_id
          AND c.created_by = p_user_id
    );
$function$

functions.name: is_blocked_between
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_blocked_between(p_user_a uuid, p_user_b uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.blocks b
        WHERE
            (b.blocker_id = p_user_a AND b.blocked_id = p_user_b)
            OR
            (b.blocker_id = p_user_b AND b.blocked_id = p_user_a)
    );
$function$
